name: routes
lead: How players get between the worlds of the group.

functions.name: add
functions.signature: routes.add(route: { from: string, to: string, trigger: { block: string, ticks: number ? }?, placement: Vec3 ? })
functions.description: From one dimension to another: standing `ticks` ticks in `block`, or only by `player:travel` without a trigger; arriving at `placement` or the destination's spawn.
